menu.albiz.subtitle: ALTAI · RED MOON · FREE SPIRIT
module.crystal-aura.name: Crystal Aura
module.crystal-aura.description: Places and breaks end crystals for the most damage.
module.shield-breaker.name: Shield Breaker
module.shield-breaker.description: Swaps to an axe for any hit into a raised shield. Auto also makes the hit.
module.aim-assist.name: Aim Assist
module.aim-assist.description: Eases your crosshair onto the nearest enemy player while you move the mouse.
module.auto-trap.name: Auto Trap
module.auto-trap.description: Boxes the nearest enemy in with obsidian: sides at feet and head height, then the top.
module.crystal-optimizer.name: Crystal Optimizer
module.crystal-optimizer.description: Removes crystals client-side as soon as your hit breaks them.
module.autototem.name: Auto Totem
module.autototem.description: Refills an empty offhand with a totem from your inventory, at a human pace you choose with Refill Delay.
module.jump-reset.name: Jump Reset
module.jump-reset.description: Jumps the tick knockback lands to take less of it.
module.fastxp.name: FastXP
module.fastxp.description: Throws experience bottles faster while use is held.
module.w-tap-recode.name: W Tap
module.w-tap-recode.description: Resets your sprint right after a sprint hit so the next hit knocks back too.
module.anchor-aura.name: Anchor Aura
module.anchor-aura.description: Places, charges and detonates respawn anchors on nearby enemies.
module.anchor-macro.name: Anchor Macro
module.anchor-macro.description: Places, charges and blows up respawn anchors on right-click.
module.fake-lag.name: Fake Lag
module.fake-lag.description: Holds your outgoing packets for a moment so the server sees you a little behind. Dynamic: only while you walk at the player you aim at.
module.knockback-delay.name: Knockback Delay
module.knockback-delay.description: Takes some hits' knockback a random moment late: a little in the air, longer on the ground.
module.autoinvtotem.name: Auto Inventory Totem
module.autoinvtotem.description: Refills the offhand totem after a pop through the inventory or a hotbar swap; Double Hand also keeps one in the main hand while in danger.
module.auto-city.name: Auto City
module.auto-city.description: Mines a surround block of the best enemy in a hole, then turns off so Crystal Aura can blow through it.
module.spear-swap.name: Spear Swap
module.spear-swap.description: Swaps to your Lunge spear and lunges. Reach Poke stabs with a spear past sword reach.
module.mace.name: Mace
module.mace.description: Swaps to the strongest mace for smash hits, with an optional smash assist.
module.hovertotem.name: Hover Totem
module.hovertotem.description: Swaps a hovered totem from any open container into the offhand or selected hotbar slot.
module.friend-guard.name: Friend Guard
module.friend-guard.description: Stops you from hitting players on your friends list.
module.kill-aura.name: Kill Aura
module.kill-aura.description: Attacks nearby targets without moving your camera.
module.key-throw.name: Key Throw
module.key-throw.description: Throws a pearl or a wind charge with a key and swaps back.
module.crystal-macro.name: Crystal Macro
module.crystal-macro.description: Breaks and places crystals while you hold right-click.
module.triggerbot.name: Triggerbot
module.triggerbot.description: Hits the entity under the crosshair once the swing is charged, with a reaction delay.
module.target-esp.name: Target ESP
module.target-esp.description: Draws an Steppe mark on your combat target.
module.particles.name: Particles
module.particles.description: Steppe particles for totem pops, projectiles and footsteps.
module.low-health-warning.name: Low Health Warning
module.low-health-warning.description: Flashes the screen edges when your health is low.
module.spawner-notifier.name: Spawner Notifier
module.spawner-notifier.description: Scans chunks for mob spawners and highlights them.
module.fullbright.name: Fullbright
module.fullbright.description: Brighten dark areas by overriding the client lightmap gamma.
module.block-entity-debug.name: Block Entity Debug
module.block-entity-debug.description: Renders every leaked block entity as ESP (always-on Netty capture), plus blocks the server hides but still gives away through chest/crafter events, sounds and light.
module.block-overlay.name: Block Overlay
module.block-overlay.description: A smooth, animated outline and fill on the block you look at.
module.tracers.name: Tracers
module.tracers.description: Displays tracer lines to specified entities.
module.xray.name: Xray
module.xray.description: Hide or fade everything but a block whitelist to see ores through terrain.
module.time-changer.name: Time Changer
module.time-changer.description: Makes you able to set a custom time.
module.glow-esp.name: Glow ESP
module.glow-esp.description: Outlines entities through walls with a glow.
module.chunk-scanner.name: Chunk Scanner
module.chunk-scanner.description: Marks suspicious chunks with signs of player activity.
module.custom-crosshair.name: Custom Crosshair
module.custom-crosshair.description: Draws a configurable crosshair in place of the vanilla one.
module.freelook.name: Freelook
module.freelook.description: Turns the camera and the player separately.
module.jump-circles.name: Jump Circles
module.jump-circles.description: Draws a fading Albiz ring where you jump.
module.block-esp.name: Block ESP
module.block-esp.description: Highlights chosen blocks; touching blocks merge into one shape.
module.storage-esp.name: Storage ESP Bypass
module.storage-esp.description: Highlights received storage data. Orebfuscator mode separates block-entity packets from unconfirmed event, sound and light hints; it cannot reconstruct server-only positions.
module.hand-aura.name: Hand Aura
module.hand-aura.description: Adds a glowing outline to your hand and held item.
module.nametags.name: Nametags
module.nametags.description: Player nametags with held items, armour, health, ping and distance.
module.custom-fov.name: Custom Fov
module.custom-glint.name: Custom Glint
module.custom-glint.description: Recolours the enchantment glint and changes its speed and pattern size.
module.weapon-inspect.name: CS Knife
module.weapon-inspect.description: Knife skins for your sword and CS-style inspects with a key of your choice (F by default); hold the key to keep the knife spinning.
module.item-esp.name: Item ESP
module.item-esp.description: Highlights selected dropped items with model outlines and tracers.
module.trajectories.name: Trajectories
module.trajectories.description: Shows where your projectiles will land.
module.swing-animation.name: Swing Animation
module.wolf-crest.name: Wolf Crest
module.wolf-crest.description: Puts a wolf crest on your player model.
module.esp.name: ESP
module.esp.description: Highlights players, hostile and passive mobs with outlines, boxes and tracers.
module.better-sus-chunk.name: Better Sus Chunk
module.better-sus-chunk.description: Marks chunks no player has been near: areas with overdue natural growth rule themselves out.
module.waypoints.name: Waypoints
module.waypoints.description: Saved places shown on screen with distance. Entries are "Name x y z", optionally ending in nether or end.
module.totem-spirit.name: Totem Spirit
module.totem-spirit.description: A glowing ghost rises when a player pops a totem.
module.no-render.name: No Render
module.no-render.description: Hide selected overlays, screen effects and entity renders.
module.sus-chunk-finder.name: Sus Chunk Finder
module.sus-chunk-finder.description: Finds chunks with signs of player activity from grown amethyst, kelp, vines, bamboo, cocoa and bee nests.
module.hand-pose.name: Hand Pose
module.hand-pose.description: Moves, rotates and resizes your first-person hands.
module.color-grading.name: Color Grading
module.color-grading.description: Adds color, contrast and a vignette to the world.
module.floating-relics.name: Floating Relics
module.floating-relics.description: Glowing orbs float around you and leave a trail as they move.
module.motion-blur.name: Motion Blur
module.motion-blur.description: Adds motion blur when you turn.
module.zoom.name: Zoom
module.zoom.description: Hold the key to zoom in.
module.atmosphere.name: Atmosphere
module.atmosphere.description: A custom sky with stars and an aurora.
module.hit-particles.name: Hit Particles
module.hit-particles.description: Spawns particles where your hits land.
module.light-debug.name: Light Debug
module.spawner-nametags.name: Spawner Nametags
module.spawner-nametags.description: Shows each spawner's mob and activation range over the block.
module.hole-esp.name: Hole ESP
module.pearl-trajectory.name: Pearl Trajectory
module.pearl-trajectory.description: Predicts where a held pearl lands and previews the flight of thrown pearls.
module.3d-hand.name: 3D Hand
module.3d-hand.description: Shows your own arm holding the item in first person: swords, tools, items and blocks.
module.spam.name: Spam
module.fast-use.name: Fast Use
module.fast-use.description: Places blocks and uses items faster while use is held.
module.legit-auto-tool.name: Legit Auto Tool
module.legit-auto-tool.description: Auto tool that only switches hotbar slots like a player.
module.slow-swing.name: Slow Swing
module.block-notifier.name: Block Notifier
module.block-notifier.description: Shows a toast with the block and its coordinates when one of your chosen blocks shows up.
module.air-stuck.name: Air Stuck
module.air-stuck.description: Freezes you in place, even mid-air.
module.chat-macro.name: Chat Macro
module.chat-macro.description: Sends chat messages or commands with a key press.
module.auto-clicker.name: Auto Clicker
module.auto-clicker.description: Clicks the left and/or right mouse button at a randomised, human CPS.
module.auto-relog.name: Auto Relog
module.auto-relog.description: Relogs once when you go down to deepslate level.
module.weather-notifier.name: Weather Notifier
module.weather-notifier.description: Shows an advancement-style toast when it starts raining.
module.netherite-finder.name: Netherite Finder
module.netherite-finder.description: Boxes Nether chunk sections hiding ancient debris.
module.freecam.name: Freecam
module.discord-presence.name: Discord Presence
module.discord-presence.description: Shows Albız Client and the server you are on in your Discord status.
module.auto-eat.name: Auto Eat
module.auto-eat.description: Eats hotbar or offhand food once hunger or health drops too low.
module.name-protect.name: Name Protect
module.name-protect.description: Shows aliases instead of player names on your screen.
module.media-base-finder.name: Media Base Finder
module.media-base-finder.description: Tells you which DonutSMP media are on the goliath you land on (after /rtp), where their base most likely is.
module.player-detection.name: Player Detection
module.player-detection.description: Detects when players are in the world.
module.fake-stats.name: Fake Stats
module.fake-stats.description: Shows your own name and stats on the sidebar and tab list. Blank stats get scrambled.
module.anti-vanish.name: Anti Vanish
module.staff-live.name: Staff Live
module.staff-live.description: Tells you when DonutSMP staff go live on YouTube or TikTok: a chat line with a watch link, a chime, and a panel with the stream title while they are live. Channels are yt:handle or tt:handle.
module.spawner-protect.name: Spawner Protect
module.spawner-protect.description: Protects spawners on block updates; player arrivals only send webhook notifications.
module.skin-change.name: Skin Change
module.no-inv-leak.name: No Inv Leak
module.no-inv-leak.description: Hides your items on screen for screen shares. Stream Only keeps them visible to you alone.
module.anti-trap.name: Anti Trap
module.anti-trap.description: Allows you to escape from armor stands and chest minecarts.
module.player-bypass.name: Player Bypass
module.player-bypass.description: Finds hidden players from light data and from chunks that keep ticking outside your simulation distance.
module.goliath-rtp.name: Goliath RTP
module.goliath-rtp.description: Opens a map of every goliath: pick as many as you like and it uses /rtp until you land on one of them.
module.anti-ghost-block.name: Anti Ghost Block
module.anti-ghost-block.description: Stops invisible ghost blocks when mining: a broken block stays visible until the server confirms the break.
module.auto-reconnect.name: Auto Reconnect
module.auto-reconnect.description: Reconnects to the last server after an unexpected disconnect.
module.amethyst-bypass.name: Amethyst Bypass
module.amethyst-bypass.description: Shows amethyst geodes hidden by anti-xray.
module.donut-nofall.name: Donut NoFall
module.donut-nofall.description: Take no fall damage on DonutSMP.
module.coord-snapper.name: Coord Snapper
module.coord-snapper.description: Copies the coordinates you look at or stand on with one key.
module.trident-util.name: Better Trident
module.trident-util.description: Use tridents out of water and charge them faster.
module.staff-list.name: Staff List
module.entity-speed.name: Entity Speed
module.entity-speed.description: Makes you go faster horizontally when riding entities.
module.fly.name: Fly
module.boat-noclip.name: Boat Noclip
module.boat-noclip.description: Fly your boat through blocks and entities.
module.auto-jump.name: Auto Jump
module.no-jump-delay.name: No Jump Delay
module.spider.name: Spider
module.spider.description: Allows you to climb walls like a spider.
module.sprint.name: Sprint
module.sprint.description: Keeps you sprinting while you move forward, like vanilla Toggle Sprint.
module.sneak.name: Sneak
module.click-tp.name: Click TP
module.click-tp.description: Teleports you to the block you click on.
module.auto-walk.name: Auto Walk
module.speed.name: Speed
module.speed.description: Modifies your movement speed when moving on the ground.
module.boat-fly.name: Boat Fly
module.boat-fly.description: Transforms your boat (or any ridden vehicle) into a plane.
module.trident-boost.name: Trident Boost
module.trident-boost.description: Boosts you when using riptide with a trident.
module.elytra-swap.name: Elytra Swap
module.elytra-swap.description: Swaps between your chestplate and elytra with one key.
module.entity-control.name: Entity Control
module.entity-control.description: Lets you control rideable entities without a saddle.
module.jesus.name: Jesus
module.jesus.description: Walk on liquids and powder snow like Jesus.
module.elytra-fly.name: Elytra Fly
module.elytra-fly.description: Gives you more control over your elytra.
module.hotkeys.name: Hotkeys
module.hotkeys.description: Lists the modules you have bound to a key, and their keys.
module.hud.name: HUD
module.hud.description: Module list, coordinates and status overlays.
module.region-map.name: Region Map
module.region-map.description: DonutSMP goliath map with directional indicator.
module.radar.name: Radar
module.radar.description: A round radar of the players around you.
module.performance.name: Performance
module.performance.description: Reduces background work and image memory while keeping effects and features. Disable to compare FPS.
module.spotify-hud.name: Spotify HUD
module.spotify-hud.description: Shows what Spotify is playing, with synced lyrics and optional media keys.
module.ah-sell.name: AH Sell
module.ah-sell.description: Lists up to 9 items from your inventory on the Auction House at your price or the cheapest price.
module.order-ah-seller.name: Order AH Trader
module.order-ah-seller.description: Sells an item on the Auction House, undercuts other sellers and restocks through orders.
module.ah-sniper.name: AH Sniper
module.ah-sniper.description: Refreshes the AH and instantly buys your item below your price, with optional auto selling.
module.tp-macro.name: Tp Macro
module.tp-macro.description: Sends /tpa or /tpahere to one player on a timer.
module.auto-sell.name: Auto Sell
module.auto-sell.description: Keeps the /sell menu open and keeps selling everything that is not on your Never Sell list.
module.panic-pay.name: Panic Pay
module.panic-pay.description: Sells your whole inventory and armor with /sell, then pays all your money to one player.
module.order-dropper.name: Order Dropper
module.order-dropper.description: Opens one of your orders, collects it and drops the chosen number of pages, then turns off.
module.auto-tpahere.name: Tpahere Kill Bot
module.auto-tpahere.description: Sends tpahere requests to online players one by one, pauses when someone arrives and fights them. Servers can detect this.
module.character-3d.name: 3D Character
module.character-3d.description: Replaces your player model with a 3D character.
module.sword-bot.name: Sword PvP Bot
module.sword-bot.description: Fights the nearest enemy player with a sword or axe: keeps out of their reach while charging, times crits, strafes and eats gapples.
module.crystal-bot.name: Crystal PvP Bot
module.crystal-bot.description: Crystal-fights the nearest enemy player: steers the Crystal and Anchor Aura, knocks them up, breaks their hole, guards, eats, mends, refills and pearls.
